blocks.content: Quiz: Suppose a Dog class is derived from an Animal class. Then, which of the following statements is correct?
Tap an option below to answer:
The Animal class inherits all the attributes and methods of the Dog class.
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the methods and attributes of the base class (parent class), not the other way around.
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the methods and attributes of the base class (parent class), not the other way around.
Both classes inherit each other's attributes and methods.
Only the derived class inherits the base class's methods and attributes.
Only the derived class inherits the base class's methods and attributes.
The Dog class inherits all the attributes and methods of the Animal class.
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the methods and attributes of the base class (parent class).
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the methods and attributes of the base class (parent class).
One of the answers is correct.
One of the answers is correct.
